shortDescription: Opens an application in the VDI by name and waits for its window. Run it when a task needs an app open.
description: Starts with a VDI session open on any screen. Presses Win+R, types the name, presses Enter and waits for the app's window. Leaves the app's window in front.

devices.description: The VDI client window on the host or a PiKVM'd PC
